Name: Stone Bridge Over Pond
Author: jinxiewinxie
Description:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/HOxdkrE.png[/img]


[b]Information:[/b]

This mod was a labor of love and created despite [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/501530/?]Advize[/url] (almost) encouraging me to give up ^_^

Requires SMAPI 0.39.6 or later.

It adds a bridge over the lower pond on the farm map, so that you can quickly access the path leading south. It doesn't require replacing any .xnb files.

Here's a .gif showing the mod in action:

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/GrydQbH2j52c8/giphy.gif[/img]


[b]Download:
[/b]
[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/316]Download Here[/url] on the Nexus (just click the file name or "download manually". Ensure you are using SMAPI 0.39.6 or above. 


[b]Installation Instructions:

[list]
[*]Download the mod
[*]Extract the archive
[*]Go to AppData\Roaming\StardewValley
[*]Add the folder inside the Mods folder
[/list][/b]
[b]
To use:
[/b]
Just start your game using StardewModdingAPI.exe and you'll see the bridge once you load up your save and walk south on the farm.

[b]Credits:
[/b]
The initial idea for this was inspired by a [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/bridges-n-stuff.112711/]request on the official forums[/url].
